{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module ContainerOrch where

import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.IORef
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Control.Monad (when, unless)

-- Types for multi-tenant container orchestration
data Tenant = Tenant
  { tenantId   :: Text
  , tenantName :: Text
  , tenantTier :: Tier
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

data Tier = Free | Pro | Enterprise deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

data Container = Container
  { containerId    :: Text
  , containerOwner :: Text  -- tenantId of owner
  , containerImage :: Text
  , containerState :: ContainerState
  , sharedWith     :: [Text]  -- list of tenantIds with access
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

data ContainerState = Running | Stopped | Paused deriving (Show, Eq)

data Permission = Owner | SharedAccess | NoAccess deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

data OrchState = OrchState
  { tenants    :: Map Text Tenant
  , containers :: Map Text Container
  , auditLog   :: [(Text, Text, Text)]  -- (who, action, target)
  }

type StateRef = IORef OrchState

-- Initialize orchestrator state
initState :: IO StateRef
initState = newIORef $ OrchState Map.empty Map.empty []

-- Register a new tenant
registerTenant :: StateRef -> Text -> Text -> Tier -> IO ()
registerTenant ref tid name tier = do
  modifyIORef' ref $ \s ->
    s { tenants = Map.insert tid (Tenant tid name tier) (tenants s) }

-- Resolve the effective permission for a tenant on a container
-- This implements a hierarchical resolution: Owner > SharedAccess > NoAccess
resolvePermission :: OrchState -> Text -> Container -> Permission
resolvePermission state requesterId container
  | containerOwner container == requesterId = Owner
  | requesterId `elem` sharedWith container = SharedAccess
  | otherwise = NoAccess

-- Namespace resolution: containers are addressed as "tenant/container-id"
-- This allows cross-tenant references for shared containers
resolveContainerRef :: OrchState -> Text -> Text -> Maybe (Text, Container)
resolveContainerRef state requesterId ref =
  let parts = T.splitOn "/" ref
  in case parts of
    [cid] -> 
      -- Unqualified: look up in requester's namespace
      case Map.lookup cid (containers state) of
        Just c | containerOwner c == requesterId -> Just (cid, c)
        _ -> Nothing
    [namespace, cid] ->
      -- Qualified: look up the container and verify the namespace matches owner
      let fullId = cid
      in case Map.lookup fullId (containers state) of
        Just c | containerOwner c == namespace -> Just (fullId, c)
        _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing

-- Deploy a container for a tenant
deployContainer :: StateRef -> Text -> Text -> Text -> IO (Either Text ())
deployContainer ref requesterId cid image = do
  state <- readIORef ref
  case Map.lookup requesterId (tenants state) of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Unknown tenant"
    Just tenant ->
      -- Prevent hijacking/overwriting an existing container (possibly owned
      -- by another tenant) that shares the same container id.
      case Map.lookup cid (containers state) of
        Just _  -> return $ Left "Container id already exists"
        Nothing -> do
          let container = Container cid requesterId image Running []
          modifyIORef' ref $ \s -> s
            { containers = Map.insert cid container (containers s)
            , auditLog = (requesterId, "deploy", cid) : auditLog s
            }
          return $ Right ()

-- Stop a container - requires Owner or SharedAccess permission
stopContainer :: StateRef -> Text -> Text -> IO (Either Text ())
stopContainer ref requesterId containerRef = do
  state <- readIORef ref
  case resolveContainerRef state requesterId containerRef of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Container not found"
    Just (cid, container) -> do
      let perm = resolvePermission state requesterId container
      case perm of
        NoAccess -> return $ Left "Access denied"
        _ -> do
          let updated = container { containerState = Stopped }
          modifyIORef' ref $ \s -> s
            { containers = Map.insert cid updated (containers s)
            , auditLog = (requesterId, "stop", cid) : auditLog s
            }
          return $ Right ()

-- Delete a container - requires Owner permission only
deleteContainer :: StateRef -> Text -> Text -> IO (Either Text ())
deleteContainer ref requesterId containerRef = do
  state <- readIORef ref
  case resolveContainerRef state requesterId containerRef of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Container not found"
    Just (cid, container) -> do
      let perm = resolvePermission state requesterId container
      case perm of
        Owner -> do
          modifyIORef' ref $ \s -> s
            { containers = Map.delete cid (containers s)
            , auditLog = (requesterId, "delete", cid) : auditLog s
            }
          return $ Right ()
        _ -> return $ Left "Only owner can delete"

-- Share a container with another tenant
shareContainer :: StateRef -> Text -> Text -> Text -> IO (Either Text ())
shareContainer ref requesterId containerRef targetTenantId = do
  state <- readIORef ref
  case resolveContainerRef state requesterId containerRef of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Container not found"
    Just (cid, container) -> do
      let perm = resolvePermission state requesterId container
      case perm of
        Owner -> do
          let updated = container { sharedWith = targetTenantId : sharedWith container }
          modifyIORef' ref $ \s -> s
            { containers = Map.insert cid updated (containers s)
            , auditLog = (requesterId, "share", cid <> "->" <> targetTenantId) : auditLog s
            }
          return $ Right ()
        _ -> return $ Left "Only owner can share"

-- Inspect container details - requires at least SharedAccess
inspectContainer :: StateRef -> Text -> Text -> IO (Either Text Container)
inspectContainer ref requesterId containerRef = do
  state <- readIORef ref
  case resolveContainerRef state requesterId containerRef of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Container not found"
    Just (cid, container) -> do
      let perm = resolvePermission state requesterId container
      case perm of
        NoAccess -> return $ Left "Access denied"
        _ -> do
          modifyIORef' ref $ \s -> s
            { auditLog = (requesterId, "inspect", cid) : auditLog s }
          return $ Right container
